events.title: Ferdowsi completes the 'Shahnameh'
events.description: After some thirty years' work, the poet Ferdowsi finished his epic of the kings of Iran, around 50,000 couplets long. Written in Persian with few Arabic words, it is Iran's national epic.
events.html: After some thirty years' work, the poet Ferdowsi finished his epic of the kings of Iran, around 50,000 couplets long. Written in Persian with few Arabic words, it is Iran's national epic.

events.title: Anne becomes queen on the death of William III
events.description: William III died after a fall from his horse, and his sister-in-law Anne succeeded. During her reign England and Scotland united as Great Britain in 1707.
events.html: William III died after a fall from his horse, and his sister-in-law Anne succeeded. During her reign England and Scotland united as Great Britain in 1707.

events.title: New York brokers form the New York Stock and Exchange Board
events.description: Brokers adopted a constitution and rented rooms on Wall Street, building on the Buttonwood Agreement of 1792. Their exchange became the New York Stock Exchange.
events.html: Brokers adopted a constitution and rented rooms on Wall Street, building on the Buttonwood Agreement of 1792. Their exchange became the New York Stock Exchange.

events.title: Raymonde de Laroche becomes the first licensed woman pilot
events.description: The Aéro-Club de France issued licence no. 36 to the French aviator. She set altitude records before dying in a crash in 1919.
events.html: The Aéro-Club de France issued licence no. 36 to the French aviator. She set altitude records before dying in a crash in 1919.

events.title: Protests in Petrograd begin the February Revolution
events.description: On International Women's Day (23 February Old Style), women textile workers protesting about bread shortages began strikes that spread across the city. Within a week Tsar Nicholas II had abdicated.
events.html: On International Women's Day (23 February Old Style), women textile workers protesting about bread shortages began strikes that spread across the city. Within a week Tsar Nicholas II had abdicated.

events.title: Japanese forces occupy Rangoon
events.description: Japanese troops entered Burma's capital, abandoned by the British. The loss cut the Burma Road supply route to China, and by May Japan controlled most of Burma.
events.html: Japanese troops entered Burma's capital, abandoned by the British. The loss cut the Burma Road supply route to China, and by May Japan controlled most of Burma.

events.title: Joe Frazier beats Muhammad Ali in the 'Fight of the Century'
events.description: At Madison Square Garden, Frazier won a unanimous decision after knocking Ali down in the 15th round. It was Ali's first professional defeat.
events.html: At Madison Square Garden, Frazier won a unanimous decision after knocking Ali down in the 15th round. It was Ali's first professional defeat.

intl.name: International Women's Day
intl.description: Celebrated since the early twentieth century and adopted by the United Nations in 1977, International Women's Day recognises women's social, economic, cultural, and political achievements while calling for gender equality worldwide.
